name: west-coast-charts
description: Render, validate and describe charts headlessly: SVG/PNG plus a verification table for agents.
long_description:
Official West Coast Charts MCP server: render, validate and describe charts headlessly (SVG/PNG + verification table), option schema slices and curated examples for AI agents.

All tools are read-only and deterministic; nothing is written to disk and no network is used. Premium chart types need a licence key.

prompts.name: build_dashboard
prompts.description: Plan and build a multi-chart West Coast Charts dashboard for a goal, validating and verifying every chart.
prompts.text: Plan and build a multi-chart West Coast Charts dashboard for a goal, validating and verifying every chart. goal: ${arguments.goal}, data: ${arguments.data}, charts: ${arguments.charts}

prompts.name: pick_chart_type
prompts.description: Recommend the best West Coast Charts type for a dataset and question, with a validated starter spec.
prompts.text: Recommend the best West Coast Charts type for a dataset and question, with a validated starter spec. data: ${arguments.data}, question: ${arguments.question}

license_key.title: Licence key (Premium)
license_key.description: Only needed for premium chart types (sankey, chord, radialColumn, ...). Leave empty for free types.

default_theme.title: Default theme
default_theme.description: light or dark, used when a spec sets no theme.mode.

evaluation.title: Evaluation mode
evaluation.description: Without a licence key, render premium chart types with an "unlicensed" watermark instead of failing.
